Wizard-study: Three grimoires splayed open atop one another, a brass astrolabe wedged between inkpots, half-melted tallow candles crusted onto the desk, a cracked crucible still faintly smoking, loose parchment covered in crossed-out equations, a quill split at the nib, and a small jar of iridescent powder with no label.

Hermit-hut: Bundles of dried yarrow and mugwort hang from every rafter beam, clay pots of varying sizes crowd the hearthstones, a deer pelt is draped over a three-legged stool, and a collection of hand-carved wooden tokens lies scattered across a bark-cloth mat near the door.

Glowing-cave: Rose-quartz shards line a natural shelf cut into the cave wall beside a battered tin cup, a rope hammock sags between two stalagmites, a soot-blackened iron pot rests on hearthstones, and a folded wool blanket sits next to a small pile of personal letters sealed with wax.

Swamp-shack: Woven reed mats overlap on the floor, dried cattail stalks bundle in the corner, clay jars of murky bog-water line the window ledge, a tangle of fishing-lines hangs from a peg, and a string of bird-bones clicks softly in the draught beside a rusted gutting-knife.

Druid-hollow: Gnarled root-shelves hold rows of green-glass bottles stopped with cork and beeswax, clusters of softly glowing amber mushrooms grow along the base of the walls, a moss-stuffed sleeping pallet fills one alcove, and carved-bone tools for cutting and grinding rest in a smooth hollow in the trunk.

Observatory: A great brass orrery dominates the central table, its rings dusty but its pivot oiled, surrounded by rolled star-charts weighted at the corners with iron discs, a long-lens telescope on a tilting mount, and a stack of parchment ledgers recording nightly observations in cramped, precise script.

Magical-bookshop: Shelves bow under the weight of volumes stacked two-deep, scrolls wedge into every gap, a brass reading-lamp on an adjustable arm leans over the central lectern, and a clutter of oddments fills the gaps between books — a glass eye, a sealed vial of silver dust, a fragment of runic tile.

Wizard-study: A brass orrery sits half-disassembled on one corner of the desk, its gears and rings laid out on a velvet square, next to a tower of annotated folios, three different sizes of measuring callipers, a pot of sealing wax, and a raven feather used as a secondary quill.

Hermit-hut: Mushrooms dry on a strung cord above the hearth, their edges curling brown, a clay bowl holds cracked hazelnuts and dried berries, a rough-woven blanket pools on a straw-tick mattress, iron pot-hooks hold two mismatched cauldrons, and a row of hand-knotted herb sachets hangs from a low beam.

Swamp-shack: Feathers of heron and crow are threaded on wire stretched between posts, a large clay jar sealed with pitch squats in the corner, cured frog-skins dry on small stretching-frames, coiled rope and a long-handled net pile near the door, and a crude tallow-dip candle gutters on a shelf of split wood.

Glowing-cave: Pale blue crystal formations cluster at the rear wall, their glow reflecting off a polished tin mirror propped on a stone ledge beside a wooden comb and a leather belt rolled around a spare buckle, while a wool-stuffed pallet and a coarsely woven blanket occupy a flat shelf of natural stone.

Druid-hollow: Bottles of pressed elderflower oil and blackthorn extract fill a root-shelf beside a set of carved-bone needles for setting fractures, the floor is banked with deep moss, and a knotted cord holding dried seed-clusters hangs at the entrance as both calendar and charm against ill weather.

Observatory: Loose parchment star-maps cover every flat surface, annotated in rust-brown ink with constellation names and conjunction dates, a set of brass sighting-rings hangs on a wall-peg, a pair of fine glass lenses wrapped in chamois cloth rest in an open case, and a half-eaten heel of bread sits forgotten beside the inkwell.

Wizard-study: Shelves crowd every wall, interspersed with small caged candles for reading-light, a green-glass alembic drips slowly into a clay receiver, a rolled scroll bound in red ribbon protrudes from an overflowing pigeonhole, and a stack of wax tablets scratched with working-notes tilts dangerously against a mortar and pestle stained purple.

Magical-bookshop: A leather-bound ledger of acquisitions lies open on the counter, a cluster of small oddities share a shelf with theological commentaries — a basilisk scale, a pinned moth of unusual size, a sealed clay amulet — and scrolls of varying age protrude from a standing rack behind a low-burning oil lamp in a bronze cradle.

Hermit-hut: A large bunch of fresh-cut rosemary hangs beside older bundles of grey lavender, small clay pots along the sill hold seeds in damp sand, a skinning-knife rests in its leather sheath on the workbench beside a coil of sinew thread, and a fur-lined cloak hangs on a peg near the low wooden door.

Swamp-shack: A broad wickerwork tray holds sorted bones — small animal, bird, and one that is difficult to identify — alongside a pouch of dried bog-berries, a tar-sealed clay pot of rendered fat for weatherproofing, and a long willow-withe fishing-rod leans in the corner next to a creel of woven rush.

Glowing-cave: Mineral-encrusted shelves hold a collection of personal objects: a travelling journal with a brass clasp, a folded letter, a tarnished pilgrim badge, and a small religious medallion on a cord, all arranged beside a row of crystal shards graded by colour and placed with obvious deliberate care on smoothed stone.

Druid-hollow: A woven-grass basket holds acorns, dried berries, and folded bark-sheets for writing, a clay oil-lamp on a fungal shelf casts warm orange light across the space, and a set of carved antler-tine tools for surgery and plant-work lies rolled in a strip of cured leather near the moss-cushioned sleeping hollow.

Wizard-study: An ink-stained wooden stand holds a half-completed manuscript, its margins crowded with tiny annotations and small diagrams, an overturned brass compass sits beside a pot of dried-up black ink, a tallow candle has burned down and sealed itself in its own wax to the corner of an opened encyclopaedia of celestial bodies.

Observatory: A hinged case of graduated brass rings for measuring celestial angles rests open beside a night-log with entries running to the current date, a sky-chart pinned to the curved wall shows pencil corrections made over old ink, and a cold cup of herbed broth sits next to a burnt-down stub of beeswax candle.

Magical-bookshop: Volumes on thaumaturgy, herbalism, cartography, and demonology share shelves in no particular order, with bookmarks of ribbon, straw, and a shed snake-skin protruding at intervals, and below the main counter a cabinet holds curiosities under glass — a small sealed urn, a lens that inverts its view, a fragment of inscribed bone.

Hermit-hut: Strips of dried meat hang beside herb-bundles on the same rafter, a blackened iron pot on its tripod holds a cold grey stew, rough tallow candles in clay holders line the hearth-shelf, and a stack of birch-bark squares scratched with personal symbols — a private written language — occupies a corner of the sleeping bench.

Swamp-shack: Dried toad-skins stretch on bent-withe frames along the wall, a clay jar of rendered bog-reed oil sits stoppered on the shelf, a net in need of repair occupies the centre of the floor, and a string of small animal skulls — weasel, vole, and several unidentifiable — hangs above the single shuttered window.

Glowing-cave: A cook-pot rests over cold hearthstones, its inside crust showing a history of barley porridge and boiled roots, a cracked leather pack hangs from a driven spike holding spare bootlaces and a flint-and-steel, and personal letters in a water-tight oilcloth pouch share a crystal-lit shelf with a small carved wooden figure worn smooth by handling.

Wizard-study clutter: Three inkwells in a brass tray, two knocked sideways and long since dried to violet crusts. A half-unrolled scroll weighted by a cracked lodestone. Candle-stubs melted into constellations of wax across the desk. A leather folio stuffed fat with loose parchment covered in crossed-out equations.

Hermit-hut clutter: Bundles of dried yarrow and ghost-moss hang from every rafter-peg, shedding pale dust onto clay pots ranked along the floor. A fur-lined stool holds a half-carved wooden token. Two iron hooks bear a skinned rabbit and a string of dried mushrooms, flattened and papery as old coins.

Glowing-cave clutter: Shelves chipped directly into the cave wall hold a dented tin cup, a folded wool blanket gone grey with use, and a row of crystal shards sorted by colour — rose, bone-white, deep violet. A hammock of knotted rope sags between two stalagmites, a boot dangling from one end.

Swamp-shack clutter: Coils of braided-reed fishing line drape over a nail beside the door. Clay jars sealed with river-wax crowd a low shelf, each scratched with a different rune. Three skulls — two bird, one fish — hang on cord above the lintel, strung with brown feathers and a single yellowed tooth.

Druid-hollow clutter: Living roots arch between wall-niches that hold stoppered bottles of cloudy amber liquid. Glowing cap-mushrooms cluster in the corner, lighting a moss-padded sleeping hollow. Carved-bone needles and a worn awl rest in a split log beside a bowl of river-clay, half-worked into something with a face.
